summary: Eltek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing only its first quarter 2026 earnings release date and conference call scheduled for May 19, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer providing an earnings announcement date and conference call details. Therefore, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
